segments.motivation: Deliver projects on time, coordinate teams, and manage workflows efficiently.
Streamline agile processes, track bugs, and collaborate on code-related tasks.
Analyze campaign performance, manage marketing activities, and leverage AI for insights.

tasks.purpose: to eliminate busywork and update states
to capture action items and decisions
for focused work and iterative delivery

benefits.claim: Replaces fragmented software by offering all apps, AI, and humans in one place to maximize productivity.
Enables teams to deliver projects on time, every time through comprehensive project management features.
AI agents automate workflows, provide real-time updates, and generate content, reducing busywork and offering insights.

frictions.claim: The extensive feature set and '100+ products' integrated might overwhelm new users or require significant time to master.
Configuring and optimizing 'AI Agents & Workflows' might be challenging or time-consuming for some teams.
Connecting and syncing external applications and data sources for 'full context' might present technical difficulties or require ongoing maintenance.
